title: How AI help is controlled
summary: AI can help explain or draft learning material, but deterministic platform rules keep authority over protected decisions and state changes.

body.text: Model access must use platform-owned application ports. Domain logic does not depend on a provider's SDK, prompt, model name, or response type.

items: AI output cannot authenticate or authorize a person.
AI output cannot create an authoritative grade, financial calculation, transaction, or safety decision.
A missing or disabled provider must fall back to a bounded no-model path.
